name: /tmp/macos_gui_start.state
purpose: Boot-local schema, PID, operation, mode, phase, timestamps, and detail consumed by the Host UI without parsing logs.

name: /tmp/macws_type82_test_start
purpose: Timestamp written only by the manual type-82 layout test, never consumed by production startup.

name: /var/jb/var/mobile/macws-settings-runtime.trust-hashes
purpose: Persistent verified CDHash manifest used to restore only the reboot-volatile dynamic trustcache entries before 48-pane verification.

name: /tmp/com.macwsguide.windowing.fullscreen-request.<UUID>.plist
purpose: 15-second exact-FBS-scene fullscreen request; SpringBoard deletes it after performing or rejecting system keyboard action 11.

name: /tmp/com.macwsguide.windowing.resize-request.<UUID>.plist
purpose: 15-second exact-FBS-scene preferred-size request; SpringBoard deletes it after the immutable app-layout transaction succeeds or fails.

name: com.macwsguide.windowing.request-fullscreen
purpose: Wakeup only; authority and exact target are read from the bounded fullscreen request plist.

name: com.macwsguide.windowing.request-resize
purpose: Wakeup only; authority, dimensions and exact target are read from the bounded resize request plist.

name: NSUseRemoteSavePanel
purpose: Set in-process so Ventura AppKit uses its native NSLocalOpenPanel/NSLocalSavePanel instead of the unavailable remote ViewBridge service; this does not substitute an iOS picker.

name: /tmp/macws_vnc_activity
purpose: Boot-monotonic input timestamp selecting the 8.333 ms interactive interval for one second.

name: /tmp/macws_render_activity
purpose: Boot-monotonic timestamp, adaptive target pace, authenticated producer PID, and actual authority-matched presentation sequence published at most 10 Hz; lets WindowServer and the profiler distinguish producer demand from downstream cadence without per-frame I/O.

name: /tmp/macws_interaction_wake.sock
purpose: WindowServer-owned datagram wakeup for interrupting the current 100 ms idle completion wait; producers signal it only after publishing the corresponding activity timestamp.

name: /tmp/macws_vnc_activation_reply.sock
purpose: Bound OSXvnc acknowledgement endpoint; skips the historical fixed 20 ms wait only when macwsinputd proves the hit target is already active/frontmost.

name: /tmp/macws_vnc_damage.sock
purpose: Damage notification datagram socket.

name: /tmp/macws_vnc_fb
purpose: Retina mmap pixel transport and publication sequence.

name: MacWSLegacyFramebufferFallback
purpose: Explicitly permits the historical full-display mmap upload when DisplayStream is unavailable; production Host defaults to IOSurface-only. Enable only for an A/B with `defaults write com.macwsguide.host MacWSLegacyFramebufferFallback -bool YES` and relaunch Host.

name: com.apple.dock:showMissionControlGestureEnabled
purpose: Persisted and read back before Dock starts; owns the real vertical-negative Mission Control fluid controller.

name: com.apple.dock:showAppExposeGestureEnabled
purpose: Persisted and read back before Dock starts; owns the real vertical-positive App Expose fluid controller.

name: SkyLight managed desktop count
purpose: Cold one-Space sessions receive exactly one real adjacent Desktop before Dock starts; existing two-or-more-Space topology is preserved, enabling native horizontal fluid gestures without a Dock reload.

name: /private/tmp/macws_location_provider_ready
purpose: Current macwsinteropd PID, published only after its unmodified Ventura CLLocationManager receives a real provider update; Maps accepts it only while that exact executable remains live, and GUI teardown removes it.

name: com.macwsguide.catalyst-drawable
purpose: Foreground Host-owned bootstrap Mach receive service; each typed complex message transfers one completed IOSurface send right and is rejected on envelope, geometry, stride, pixel-format, or owner mismatch.

name: /tmp/macws-maps-host-carrier.pid
purpose: Current Maps carrier PID; every WindowServer teardown removes it after terminating Maps so a new GUI generation cannot reuse a live process with a dead CGS connection.

name: /tmp/macws_vnc_surfid
purpose: IOSurface ID compatibility state.

name: /private/tmp/macws_audio_ring
purpose: Versioned 48-kHz stereo PCM ring produced by the macOS AudioUnit callback and consumed by the iOS-native AudioQueue output helper; recreated and permission-clamped by the helper.

name: /tmp/ws_headless
purpose: Ignored and removed on upgrade; the live iPadOS backboardd process determines panel ownership.

name: /private/tmp/macws_app_input.%d.sock
purpose: Per-process AppInputBridge endpoint.

name: /private/tmp/macws_host_input.lock
purpose: Single broker ownership lock.

name: /private/tmp/macws_host_input.sock
purpose: Native-host input datagram endpoint.

name: /private/tmp/macws_input_target.sock
purpose: System input target-selection endpoint.

name: /private/tmp/macws_vscode_url.sock
purpose: Private length-framed HTTP(S)/bounded-control endpoint; each URL transaction replaces the preceding socket-owned test webview.

name: /private/tmp/macws_vscode_webview_lifecycle.json
purpose: Atomic bounded current receipt with cumulative opened/closed counters and live owned/Aquarium tab counts; no per-frame writes.

name: /tmp/macws_fast_submit_error_%d_%u
purpose: Bounded fast-ring error dump directory; production cleanup removes all.

name: /tmp/macws_submit_error_%d_%u
purpose: Heap-ring error dump directory; production cleanup removes all.

name: /tmp/macws_submit_kcmd_%u_%u_%s.bin
purpose: Raw translated command dump.

name: /tmp/macws_submit_segment_%u_%u.bin
purpose: Raw segment dump.

name: /tmp/macws_submit_type1_%u_%u.bin
purpose: Raw type-1 command dump.

name: /tmp/macws_stray_rt_c%02u_%02lu_pf%u_a%u.raw
purpose: One-shot bounded intermediate texture readback created only by /tmp/macws_stray_rt_capture_now; commercial captures stay out of Git.

name: /tmp/macws_stray_buf_c%02u_%02lu_r%u_i%u.raw
purpose: One-shot bounded intermediate buffer readback created only by /tmp/macws_stray_rt_capture_now; commercial captures stay out of Git.

name: /tmp/macws_vnc_rejected.bgra
purpose: Rejected VNC frame dump.
